ipos.name: Lighthouse Communities Foundation
ipos.about: Lighthouse Communities Foundation (LCF) is a Pune-headquartered Section 8 not-for-profit organization dedicated to empowering disadvantaged urban youth aged 18–35, particularly from slum and low-income communities, to achieve sustained livelihoods and good citizenship.Operating via a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model—leveraging government infrastructure alongside CSR and philanthropic funding—LCF delivers its flagship “Lighthouse: Centre for Skilling and Livelihood” program. The model follows a comprehensive six-stage pathway: foundational agency-building, workplace readiness (spoken English and digital literacy), personalized counselling, vocational skilling across 30+ sectors, placement support, and alumni mentoring.Additionally, LCF serves as the Indian anchor partner for the Global Opportunity Youth Network (GOYN) and runs Lighthouse Kiran for adolescent socio-emotional learning. Currently managing 51 operational centres across six Indian states, the foundation has impacted over 2.8 lakh youth since its inception.

ipos.name: Grace Cancer Foundation
ipos.about: Grace Cancer Foundation (GRACE – Global Research and Cancer Education) is a Hyderabad-based public charitable trust established on October 26, 2013, by medical professionals to alleviate the burden of cancer through accessible preventive healthcare. Operating primarily across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Karnataka, alongside global partnerships, the Foundation anchors its operations on 4 core pillars: cancer prevention through community health awareness, early detection via mobile screening bus units and rural medical camps, treatment support and patient navigation for economically disadvantaged communities, and technological research including AI-driven screening tools.The Trust holds valid regulatory registrations under Sections 12AB and 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961, and is registered under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA), 2010.

ipos.name: R.K.Fashion Accessories
ipos.about: R.K. Fashion Accessories operates as a Kolkata-based manufacturer and wholesale distributor of fashion jewellery, alongside trading in branded cosmetics. The company produces handcrafted jewellery that blends traditional designs with contemporary styles, utilizing a network of third-party contract manufacturers for its production processes. Its core business centers on distributing these products across multiple channels, including business-to-business wholesale networks, direct-to-consumer retail stores, e-commerce platforms, and a Shop-in-Shop retail model. Revenue is predominantly generated through its wholesale distribution segment, which accounts for the vast majority of its sales. The company maintains a highly concentrated market presence in eastern India, particularly in West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, and Jharkhand. By strategically combining outsourced manufacturing with a diversified sales and distribution framework, the company caters to varied market segments within the fashion and personal care sectors.
strengths: Multi-channel distribution network across B2B, B2C, e-commerce, and retail.
Diverse portfolio spanning handcrafted fashion jewellery and branded cosmetics.
Expanding scale through upcoming company-owned B2B and B2C showrooms.
Investing in an in-house plating facility to enhance manufacturing control.
Strong regional footprint with over 86% of revenue from eastern India.
risks: 100% reliant on third-party contract manufacturers.
Revenue is highly concentrated in Eastern India.
Changing fashion trends risk inventory obsolescence.
High inventory and extended receivables strain capital.
Lacks definitive agreements for proposed new showrooms.

ipos.name: Paramount Syntex
ipos.about: Paramount Syntex is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of synthetic fibers, yarns, and knitted cloth, catering to the textile industry. The company generates revenue by selling its products in domestic markets, primarily within Punjab, as well as through export sales. Its key product offerings include acrylic wool yarns, polyester yarns, nylon yarns, blended fancy yarns, and recycled acrylic fibers. Operating from its manufacturing facilities located in Ludhiana, Punjab, the company conducts in-house fiber processing, tow dyeing, hank dyeing, spinning, bulking, twisting, and packing. A notable aspect of its business model involves recycling domestic and imported waste acrylic fibers to convert them into value-added yarns. The company serves diverse end user sectors, including apparel, home textiles, hosiery, fashion knitting, and industrial textiles. Its integrated manufacturing facility enables operational efficiency and complete control over product quality and processing workflows.
strengths: Fully integrated in-house manufacturing setup.
Eco-friendly recycling of waste acrylic into premium yarns.
High capacity utilization averaging 70% to 83%.
Strict end-to-end control over quality and delivery.
Ample existing infrastructure for seamless expansion.
risks: Orders for 100% of proposed machinery remain unplaced.
Project funding requirements are unappraised by any bank.
Unhedged forex exposure risks machinery cost overruns.
Machinery procurement delays could disrupt implementation.
Heavy reliance on a single manufacturing facility in Punjab.
objectsOfIssue: Funding of capital expenditure for machinery at existing facilities (61.68(75.41%))

ipos.name: TNA Solutions
ipos.about: TNA Solutions manufactures and supplies home textile products to domestic and international markets. The company operates primarily on a business-to-business model, manufacturing customized home furnishings according to client specifications for domestic and overseas brands. Its product portfolio includes sheeting products such as flat sheets, fitted sheets, and duvet sets, as well as pillow pairs, towels, and top-of-bed items like comforters, mattress protectors, and quilts. The company also operates a direct-to-consumer segment under its brand, Ambra Linens. TNA Solutions generates revenue from the sale of these home textile goods across India and export markets including the United States, United Arab Emirates, South Africa, and the United Kingdom. Operations are conducted through its manufacturing facility situated in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, which undertakes cutting, stitching, embroidery, finishing, quality inspection, and packaging, while outsourcing fabric dyeing, printing, and other wet processing to external job workers.
strengths: Diverse home textile product portfolio serving both B2B and B2C segments.
Established international presence with exports to over ten countries.
Expanding manufacturing capacity to effectively meet rising customer demand.
Successful launch of proprietary direct-to-consumer brand, Ambra Linens.
Consistent revenue growth driven by strong relationships with key clients.
risks: Significant revenue concentration in the sheeting product segment.
Heavy reliance on a limited number of B2B customers for the majority of sales.
High working capital requirements have led to negative operating cash flows.
Business operations depend heavily on a single manufacturing facility in Indore.
Reliance on third-party job workers for essential fabric processing activities.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for new manufacturing unit and machinery (6.76(17.86%))

ipos.name: Acme India Industries
ipos.about: Acme India Industries operates in the Indian railway rolling stock sector, specializing in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of railway coach interiors. The company provides turnkey furnishing solutions for new railway coaches, refurbishment and conversion of existing coaches, and comprehensive lavatory upgrades. Its core business activities encompass designing and producing interior components such as wall panels, ceilings, toilet modules, wash basins, and mirror frames utilizing fibre-reinforced plastic and aluminum polymer composites. Revenue is primarily generated through turnkey contracts awarded on a competitive bidding basis by the Ministry of Railways, Indian Railways, and related public sector undertakings. Operating through multiple manufacturing units in Haryana, the company maintains internal capabilities to fabricate precision coach components and manage project execution across India. Focusing exclusively on passenger rail infrastructure, the company delivers integrated interior solutions tailored to meet functional, hygiene, and safety requirements specified by railway authorities.
strengths: In-house manufacturing reduces reliance on third-party vendors.
Proven execution of turnkey contracts for Indian Railways.
Broad portfolio of interior panels and toilet modules.
Strategic global tie-ups for advanced railway technology.
Capacity expansion via planned machinery procurement.
risks: High working capital requirements strain liquidity.
Revenue fully dependent on Indian Railways spending.
Outstanding legal and tax proceedings against the company.
Potential delays in executing planned capital expenditure.
Strict quality inspections with risk of order cancellations.
objectsOfIssue: Funding to meet working capital requirements (38(35.86%))
Funding Capital Expenditure for plant & machinery (6.27(5.92%))

ipos.name: Shree TNB Polymers
ipos.about: Shree TNB Polymers operates in the polymer manufacturing sector, producing a range of plastic products across its three primary divisions: the Piping Division, the Solid Industrial Sheets Division, and the Corrugated/Flute Board Sheets Division. The company’s core business involves manufacturing and distributing these items under distinct brand names, specifically Noble, Tirupati, and Balaji (Wellpack). Its manufacturing operations are centralized in two facilities located in Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli. The company generates revenue through the sale of its manufactured products to various customer segments, including business houses, other manufacturing facilities, government entities, and end consumers. These sales are facilitated through direct channels as well as an established network of over 325 dealers and distributors across multiple states. Its product offerings cater to diverse industrial and consumer needs, relying on raw materials to maintain its manufacturing output.
strengths: Diverse product portfolio across piping, corrugated, and solid industrial sheets.
Established network of over 325 dealers across key commercial hubs.
Strategically located manufacturing facilities near major industrial areas.
Proven track record of consistent revenue generation across multiple brand divisions.
Expanding market footprint across diverse regional markets and states.
risks: High dependence on top ten customers for significant portions of revenue.
Business operations rely on leased manufacturing facilities and warehouses.
Potential under-utilization of newly expanded manufacturing capacities.
Volatility in the supply and pricing of raw materials impacting profit margins.
Subject to strict regional regulations and potential penalties for delayed compliance.

Capital expenditure for solar panel/roof top (2.6 (8.33%))

ipos.name: EverestIMS Technologies
ipos.about: EverestIMS Technologies is an information technology company providing software products and services focused on IT operations and service management. The company delivers solutions across IT service management, IT infrastructure management, network configuration and content management, artificial intelligence for IT operations, IT asset management, and operations support systems. EverestIMS Technologies offers its customers multiple consumption models, providing both software as a service (SaaS) and on-premises software solutions to meet varying operational requirements. Its business involves integrating third-party open-source databases, operating systems, queuing engines, and development tools into customer deliverables. The company derives its revenue primarily from the sale of software products, software services, and hardware products to its client base, which includes large corporate customers. Additionally, the company serves clients overseas in countries such as the United Arab Emirates and Malaysia, alongside its domestic operations.
strengths: Offers multiple SaaS and on-premises software models.
Serves diverse overseas clients in the UAE and Malaysia.
Holds long-standing relationships with key corporate customers.
Adopts advanced technologies via a dedicated AI Laboratory.
Shows strong and consistent financial and revenue growth
risks: High revenue dependence on the top 10 corporate customers.
Absence of formal agreements with some channel partners.
Past negative cash flows from investing and financing.
Software defects may cause liability and customer loss.
Open-source integration exposes the company to IP infringement claims.
objectsOfIssue: Purchase of IT hardware for AI Innovation Lab (5.66 (14.49%))

ipos.name: Nityas Gems and Jewellery
ipos.about: Nityas Gems and Jewellery designs, manufactures, and sells lab-grown diamond-studded gold jewellery in India. The company operates through an integrated business model comprising business-to-business manufacturing and direct-to-consumer retail. Under its business-to-business vertical, it supplies customized and standardized jewellery to organized retail chains, standalone retailers, and wholesalers across multiple Indian states and select overseas markets. Its direct-to-consumer operations are conducted under the brand Ayaani through a subsidiary, featuring an online storefront alongside physical retail stores operated via company-owned and franchise models. The product portfolio includes rings, earrings, pendants, bracelets, mangalsutras, nose pins, necklaces, cufflinks, and bangles, with a strategic focus on lightweight, affordable luxury, and daily-wear jewellery segments. Manufacturing operations are conducted at a single facility in Surat, Gujarat, with an installed production capacity of 360 kilograms per annum, utilizing in-house karigars and computer-aided design capabilities for end-to-end jewellery fabrication.
strengths: Integrated business model spanning B2B manufacturing and D2C omnichannel retail.
Rapidly expanding customer network servicing 323 B2B clients across 18 states.
Design-led manufacturing facility in Surat supported by 122 in-house karigars.
Strong focus on high-growth, affordable lightweight lab-grown diamond jewellery.
Scalable financial performance with operating revenues compounding over 94% annually.
risks: High customer concentration with top 10 clients driving 55.49% of FY26 revenues.
Geographic concentration with five key states contributing over 85% of total sales.
Operations are working capital intensive, requiring significant ongoing funding.
Heavy reliance on top 10 suppliers who accounted for 86.16% of FY26 purchases.
All manufacturing operations are concentrated at a single facility in Surat.

ipos.name: Vishal Nirmiti
ipos.about: Vishal Nirmiti is a civil engineering, construction, and manufacturing firm operating in 2 segments. Its manufacturing arm produces pre-stressed concrete sleepers, pre-cast barriers, and steel/penstock pipes for Indian Railways and private developers. Its services arm delivers EPC solutions for railway, irrigation, and road infrastructure. The company supports regional projects through specialized manufacturing facilities across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, and Himachal Pradesh.
strengths: Diversified across railway sleepers, steel pipes, and EPC works.
Advanced in-house pipe welding and coating manufacturing plants.
Over 95% of operational revenue generated from repeat clients.
Multi-state manufacturing footprint spanning four Indian states.
Experienced promoter group with deep infrastructure expertise.
risks: High revenue dependence on Indian Railways and state tenders.
Top 5 clients account for over 85% of total operating revenue.
Substantial working capital needs funded by short-term loans.
Business relies on purchase orders without long-term contracts.
Indebtedness exposes the business to debt servicing and covenants.

ipos.name: Omara Ventures India
ipos.about: Omara Ventures India is a retail jeweller specializing in the curation and sale of designer diamond jewellery. The company offers a diverse product portfolio that includes bridal, festive, special occasion, and contemporary daily-wear jewellery, alongside gold jewellery and silver coins. Its core operations revolve around a design-led retail model operated through its boutique, where it provides customers with a personalized experience featuring customized jewellery discussions and private consultations. Omara Ventures generates revenue primarily through the direct retail sale of high-value solitaire and diamond pieces, which historically account for the vast majority of its product sales. By focusing on customization tailored to specific customer needs and maintaining well-established relationships with skilled artisans, the company successfully serves the premium market segment. Operating primarily out of the Chandigarh region, it emphasizes curated designs and a commitment to hallmarked assurance for retail investors.
strengths: Experienced promoters and a dedicated management team guiding operations.
Diversified product portfolio featuring curated diamond and gold jewellery.
Strong focus on customization based on individual customer needs.
Well-established relationships with skilled jewellery artisans and suppliers.
Deep commitment to product quality and hallmarked jewellery assurance.
risks: High dependence on suppliers for raw materials.
Revenue heavily concentrated in Solitaire and Diamond jewellery.
Geographically concentrated with operations primarily in Chandigarh.
High inventory levels significantly increase working capital needs.
Past delays and non-compliance in statutory and tax filings.

ipos.name: Dove Soft
ipos.about: Dove Soft is an integrated cloud-communications solutions provider offering multi-channel communication services to businesses. The company provides enterprise clients and over-the-top platforms with transactional Short Message Service, Rich Communication Services, WhatsApp, Voice, Interactive Voice Response, automated voice call solutions, Email, and digital marketing products. It operates on a usage-based pay-per-use revenue model, generating income based on the volume of messages and voice pulses processed through its platform. The business caters to clients across diverse industry sectors, including telecom, information technology, banking, financial services, insurance, e-commerce, retail, healthcare, real estate, automobile, travel, and food and beverages. The company engages with mobile network operators on an invoice-based arrangement and collaborates with channel partners and messaging infrastructure providers to deliver its services. Its cloud platform enables organizations to manage customer interactions, streamline business operations, and enhance messaging reach efficiently across multiple digital communication channels.
strengths: Multi-channel cloud communications provider with a scalable platform.
Diversified client base across telecom, BFSI, retail, and e-commerce sectors.
Recurring usage-based revenue model delivering consistent revenue growth.
Strategic relationships with mobile network operators and channel partners.
Experienced promoter and key management team with domain expertise.
risks: High customer concentration with top 10 clients contributing most revenue.
Substantial working capital requirements due to extended customer credit terms.
Dependency on direct telecom operators and third-party infrastructure providers.
Regional revenue concentration primarily in Northern and Western India.
Past instances of negative cash flows from operating activities.

ipos.name: Sollfege Smart Electronics
ipos.about: Sollfege Smart Electronics operates as a distributor and retailer of premium electronic products, trading across three core business segments: audio solutions, video solutions, and smart living solutions. The company generates the majority of its revenue from trading activities by sourcing high-end consumer electronics from third-party global and domestic suppliers and selling them through retail showrooms and experience centres. Its audio portfolio includes high-end speakers, home theatre systems, soundbars, and wireless speakers. The video segment offers premium projectors, televisions, and video wall systems. The smart living segment encompasses home automation systems, lifestyle and wellness equipment, as well as networking, security, and surveillance products such as smart locks, video door phones, and closed-circuit television systems. Additionally, the business provides customer support and ancillary services related to product installation and system integration. The company caters to both retail consumers and commercial clients seeking premium tech offerings.
strengths: Comprehensive product portfolio across audio, video, and smart living solutions.
Established presence with experiential retail showrooms in strategic markets.
Strong relationships with prominent global and domestic electronic brands.
Customer-centric business model featuring live product demonstrations.
Experienced promoter and key management team with deep industry knowledge.
risks: Over 90% of revenue is heavily concentrated in West Bengal.
Entirely dependent on third-party suppliers for all products.
High revenue reliance on top five brands and key customers.
History of delayed statutory and regulatory compliance filings.
Working capital-intensive business vulnerable to inventory risks.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for launching 12 new retail showrooms (8.54 (39.21%))

ipos.name: Eventions
ipos.about: Eventions operates as an integrated event management company specializing in providing Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions (MICE) solutions, corporate events, and brand activations for various institutions. The company’s core business involves the conceptualization, planning, coordination, and on-ground execution of large-format assignments across diverse domestic and international locations. It generates the vast majority of its revenue directly from the MICE segment, primarily serving domestic corporate clients on a project-to-project basis. Additionally, through its subsidiary Gantu Online Private Limited, the company is actively expanding into the business-to-consumer travel sector by offering customized Free Independent Traveller (FIT) services and curated leisure travel itineraries. To execute its projects efficiently, Eventions utilizes an asset-light operating model, relying heavily on a vetted network of third-party vendors, subcontractors, and freelance professionals for stage fabrication, logistics, and production infrastructure rather than maintaining heavy in-house physical assets.
strengths: Proven track record in execution of corporate events and conferences.
Experienced promoters with deep event management industry expertise.
Asset-light and highly scalable business operating model.
Capability to conceptualize and execute large-format corporate events.
Client-centric approach resulting in significant repeat business relationships.
risks: High dependence on a limited number of clients for repeat engagements.
Significant reliance on the MICE segment for a substantial portion of revenue.
Extensive dependence on third-party vendors for event execution.
Vulnerable to macroeconomic shifts impacting corporate event budgets.
Operations face logistical and regulatory challenges across multiple locations.
objectsOfIssue: Repayment and/or pre-payment of certain borrowings (7 (18.36%))

ipos.name: SJP Ultrasonics
ipos.about: SJP Ultrasonics primarily operates in the industrial automation solution segment, providing solutions under three business segments: Plastic Joining Solutions, Industrial Automation, and Laser Technology Solutions. The company is a start-to-finish plastic welding solution provider offering diverse and comprehensive service offerings, including specialized plastic products across varied industry segments. It customises industrial automation solutions for an array of industries such as automotive, pharmaceuticals, electronics, energy, food and beverage, packaging, material handling, water treatment, and textiles. SJP Ultrasonics designs and manufactures special-purpose machines that involve detailed fabrication processes and engineering precision on a made-to-order basis. The company integrates technologies like programmable logic controllers, supervisory control and data acquisition, human-machine interfaces, and robotics into its automation systems. SJP Ultrasonics conducts its entire manufacturing operations from its facility in Vasai, Maharashtra, generating revenue directly from customers, particularly original equipment manufacturers, through milestone-based billing without long-term contracts.
strengths: Comprehensive end-to-end plastic welding solution provider.
Strong, long-standing customer and supplier relationships.
Specialized expertise in custom, made-to-order manufacturing.
Established in-house production facilities in Maharashtra.
Experienced leadership and management team.
risks: High revenue dependence on two primary business segments.
Significant revenue concentration from a few large clients.
Raw material price volatility due to lack of long-term supplier contracts.
Working capital-intensive operations tied to trade receivables management.
Delays in new machinery procurement could hinder capacity expansion plans.
objectsOfIssue: Funding capital expenditure towards the purchase of machineries (13.22 (56.37%))

ipos.name: Green Asia Impex
ipos.about: Green Asia Impex operates as an integrated processor and exporter of frozen seafood and agricultural commodities, catering primarily to business-to-business customers, including importers, distributors, and food processing companies in domestic and international markets. The company operates in two main business segments: shrimps and dried chillies. In the shrimp segment, the company sources raw shrimps from local aquaculture farmers and traders, processes them through grading, peeling, deveining, and freezing, and supplies processed frozen shrimp products. In the dried chillies segment, the company procures chillies from agricultural market committee traders and carries out processing activities such as cleaning, grading, and sorting before distribution. Revenue is generated through direct domestic sales within India as well as exports to overseas markets including China, Kuwait, the United States, Malaysia, and the United Kingdom. The company utilizes processing facilities situated in Andhra Pradesh to manage its production operations across both product categories.
strengths: Integrated processor and exporter of frozen seafood and agricultural commodities.
Established customer relationships and presence in key international markets.
Strategically located processing facilities in Andhra Pradesh with a strong sourcing network.
Consistent financial growth with improving operating margins over recent fiscal years.
Experienced promoter group and management team with deep domain expertise.
risks: Significant revenue concentration from export sales to customers located in China.
Dependence on a limited number of large customers for a major portion of revenues.
Operations rely heavily on external borrowings to meet working capital requirements.
Absence of long-term supply contracts for raw material procurement of shrimp and chillies.
Exposure to biosecurity risks, disease outbreaks, and strict international quality standards.

ipos.name: Black Opal Consultants
ipos.about: Black Opal Consultants operates as a financial and real estate consultancy firm providing integrated real estate solutions. The company generates revenue primarily through brokerage income from selling residential and commercial properties under exclusive sales mandates with real estate developers. Additionally, it earns revenue from loan syndication fees, advisory services, and real estate project development activities. Its core business activities include acting as a channel partner for property sales, offering real estate advisory, and facilitating property financing. The company’s operations are geographically concentrated in Uttar Pradesh and Haryana, specifically in Noida, Greater Noida, and Gurugram. It is also diversifying into real estate development, including a commercial hotel project named Veda in Ayodhya through its subsidiary entity, Aurika Developers. Furthermore, the company engages in inventory underwriting for real estate developers and is developing a digital property platform called JustHomz through its wholly owned subsidiary, Black Opal Technologies.
strengths: Integrated advisory, sales, and loan syndication services.
Established channel network in the Delhi-NCR market.
Strategic expansion into Ayodhya commercial real estate.
Tech-driven approach via the JustHomz digital platform.
Highly experienced promoters and management team.

Operations highly concentrated in Uttar Pradesh and Haryana.

Investment in Aurika Developers LLP for Ayodhya project development (26 (58.97%))

ipos.name: Papadmalji Agro Foods
ipos.about: Papadmalji Agro Foods engages in the manufacturing of handmade papads, machine-made papads, rice papads, vrat special papads, and moongodi, along with the trading of cereal pellets. The company also carries out white-label manufacturing of handmade papads, producing goods that clients market under their respective brand names and tailored packaging. Revenue is primarily generated through product sales under its key core brands, including Vishal, Zhakaas, and Rozana, alongside direct-to-consumer sales under the Papadmalji brand. Products are distributed across multiple sales channels, such as general trade, modern trade, quick commerce, direct-to-consumer platforms, and sales to merchant exporters for selected Middle Eastern markets. Operations are based out of manufacturing units and facilities situated in Bikaner, Rajasthan. For handmade papad production, the business utilizes a decentralized operational system involving contractors and home-based women workers who perform hand rolling according to prescribed quality specifications before final inspection.
strengths: Established brand presence via Vishal, Zhakaas, and Rozana.
Multi-channel distribution across general and modern trade.
Scalable in-house and decentralized manufacturing model.
Diverse portfolio of papads, moongodi, and cereal pellets.
Promoters possess extensive food processing industry experience.
risks: Revenue is heavily concentrated in the papad product segment.
Significant dependency on a limited number of top customers.
Operations and core sales are geographically concentrated in Rajasthan.
Lacks long-term supply agreements for agricultural raw materials.
Core brands face pending logo registrations and trademark oppositions.

ipos.name: Vans Electroengineerings
ipos.about: Vans Electroengineerings is engaged in manufacturing and supplying components for traction power supply and overhead equipment systems used in railway electrification infrastructure, metro systems, and renewable energy applications. The company operates a single manufacturing facility in Salem, Tamil Nadu, housing product assembly, testing infrastructure, and quality control operations. It generates revenue primarily through the sale of products to Indian Railways, supplying either directly through contracts secured via competitive bidding or indirectly through associated engineering, procurement, and construction contractors and vendors. Its key product portfolio includes double pole and single pole vacuum circuit breakers, double pole and single pole vacuum interrupters, overhead equipment, and braided flexible connectors. Operating within the electrical equipment and switchgear sector, the company manufactures products designed to meet specific technical standards and regulatory specifications prescribed by railway authorities for critical power supply and traction applications.
strengths: Specialized offerings in railway electrification and traction power supply systems.
Approved vendor status with RDSO and CORE for core product verticals.
In-house assembly and testing capabilities at a dedicated manufacturing facility.
Consistent revenue growth driven by Indian Railways electrification demand.
Experienced promoter team with deep industry domain expertise.
risks: Revenue is heavily dependent on Indian Railways and its EPC contractors.
High product concentration risk from vacuum circuit breakers and interrupters.
Operations rely on a single manufacturing facility located in Salem, Tamil Nadu.
Significant working capital requirements and seasonal cash flow fluctuations.
Risk of losing or failing to renew approved vendor status with railway bodies.

ipos.name: Shah Investor's Home
ipos.about: Shah Investor’s Home is a financial services provider in India engaged primarily in stock broking across equity, commodity, derivatives, and currency segments. The company generates a major portion of its revenue from its broking segment, earning brokerage income based on traded value and order size. Alongside broking, it provides financial services including mutual fund distributorship, margin trading facility, and stock lending and borrowing. It also offers research services covering equity fundamentals, derivatives, commodities, and mutual funds to assist clients. The company earns revenue through brokerage fees, interest income from margin trading facilities, and fees and commission income from distributing third-party financial products. Catering mainly to retail investors, including resident and non-resident Indians, the company executes transactions through its head office, branch network, online trading platforms, and a network of authorized persons, with a primary market focus and business concentration in the state of Gujarat.
strengths: Established market presence with strong client concentration in Gujarat.
Diversified financial offerings including broking, MTF, and mutual funds.
Dedicated in-house research covering equities, commodities, and mutual funds.
Expanding network of authorized persons driving client acquisition.
Capital infusion will strengthen working capital and fund MTF book expansion.
risks: Over 64% of revenue depends on stock broking, primarily from Gujarat.
High working capital needs to maintain margin trading and daily settlements.
Credit and market risks from potential client defaults in margin trading.
Heavy reliance on stock exchanges and third-party trading software providers.
Past regulatory non-compliances and untraceable historical secretarial records.
objectsOfIssue: Funding the working capital requirements of the Company (70 (77.63%))

ipos.name: SRIT India
ipos.about: SRIT India is an Information Technology and Information Technology-enabled Services solutions company offering digital solutions and system automation through custom application development and integration services. The company executes large-scale, mission-critical projects primarily for central and state government bodies, alongside enterprise clients across India and international markets. Its core operations are organized into three primary verticals: electronic governance, healthcare, and telecommunications and broadband. Revenue is predominantly generated by participating in competitive bidding processes to secure tender-driven contracts from government entities, which account for a substantial majority of its business. The company’s business model involves executing turnkey projects, often partnering with third-party technology companies to deliver bundled, integrated solutions and utilizing sub-contractors for specialized tasks. Furthermore, it provides customized solutions tailored to the specific needs and regulatory environments of each industry it serves.
strengths: Established relationships with key government and enterprise clients.
Proven track record of executing large-scale, turnkey digital projects.
Specialized IT solutions for e-governance, healthcare, and telecom.
Integration of emerging technologies like AI, IoT, and cloud services.
Strategic partnerships for delivering bundled technology solutions.
risks: Highly dependent on competitive government tenders for revenue.
Top ten customers account for a substantial majority of revenue.
Working capital-intensive operations pose liquidity constraints.
Heavy reliance on third-party sub-contractors and OEMs.
Order Book projects are subject to cancellations, modifications, or delays.
objectsOfIssue: Funding capital expenditure for modernization and redevelopment (12.869 (5.89%))
Funding the working capital requirements of the Company (124 (56.78%))

ipos.name: Pind Hospitality
ipos.about: Pind Hospitality operates in the consumer food services industry, managing food delivery services and dine-in restaurants under the recognized Pind Punjab brand. The business primarily functions on a hybrid model, generating a substantial portion of its revenue through third-party food delivery applications, which accounted for over 78% of its operations in recent years. Pind Hospitality strategically focuses on the Pune geographic market, where all its current operational revenues are concentrated. Following the acquisition of a significant stake in a related partnership firm, the business is consolidating its restaurant operations to streamline its footprint. Furthermore, Pind Hospitality is diversifying its service offerings by expanding into the hospitality and event sector. It is currently developing the Haveli Project in Lonavala, Maharashtra, a hotel-cum-banquet hall designed to cater to the destination wedding market and corporate conferences, thereby broadening its core revenue streams.
strengths: Recognized Pind Punjab brand with a strong customer base in Pune.
Successful hybrid operational model spanning online delivery and dine-in.
High volume of revenue driven consistently through food delivery apps.
Strategic expansion into destination weddings via the Lonavala Haveli Project.
Strong track record of profitability and positive operating cash flows.
risks: High dependence on third-party food delivery apps for the majority of revenues.
Entire operational revenue is highly concentrated within the Pune market.
Promoters lack prior operational experience in the hotel and banquet sector.
Vulnerability to lease non-renewals and rent increases for restaurant locations.
Pending tax litigation and past delays in statutory compliance filings.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for setting up Haveli Project in Lonavala (12.7 (71.27%))

ipos.name: Shivchem Agro
ipos.about: Shivchem Agro manufactures and distributes a wide range of agrochemicals and fertilizers designed for crop protection and yield enhancement. The company’s portfolio includes insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, plant growth regulators, rodenticides, and various fertilizers. Operating from a manufacturing facility located in Jhajjar, Haryana, the business formulates chemical solutions to address diverse farming requirements. Shivchem Agro generates its revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of these agrochemical formulations across domestic markets, including Andhra Pradesh, Assam, Haryana, Telangana, Odisha, and Bihar. The company sells its offerings through an extensive distribution network, supported by strategically leased godowns across multiple Indian states to facilitate product supply and timely delivery. Raw materials are sourced from third-party suppliers on a purchase order basis to maintain continuous production. Shivchem Agro focuses on expanding its product portfolio, optimizing manufacturing capacity, and strengthening its regional market presence to effectively serve agricultural needs.
strengths: Portfolio of 176 agrochemicals and 82 fertilizers.
In-house manufacturing facility in Jhajjar, Haryana.
Network of 685 distributors across key domestic markets.
Strategically located 5 godowns ensuring efficient regional product supply.
Allocation of IPO funds for working capital expansion.
risks: Vulnerability to seasonal weather and monsoon variations.
Mandatory statutory approvals and regulatory compliances.
High working capital needs and history of negative cash flows.
Raw material price fluctuations without long-term contracts.
Operations conducted on leased plant and warehouse properties.

ipos.name: Acme Universal Safezone 9
ipos.about: Acme Universal Safezone 9 manufactures industrial safety footwear, offering durable products that adhere to industry standards, including IS 15298 and IS 1989:2020. The company generates revenue by supplying safety shoes across various sectors, relying heavily on the defence and government sectors, alongside domestic business-to-business customers through open-market procurement and government rate contracts. The core business activities involve producing safety footwear using key raw materials such as polyurethane, PVC sole compounds, genuine leather, synthetic leather, and steel toe-caps. Acme operates manufacturing facilities in Gwalior, Banthar, and Banmore, having recently consolidated its Kanpur operations into the Banthar facility to improve process efficiency. The company emphasizes manufacturing durable safety shoes through efficient processes, utilizing advanced machinery like knife cutting machines and foam pouring machines. The business maintains a diversified customer base while focusing on consistent quality and competitive pricing for retail and institutional buyers.
strengths: Experienced management team with deep industry expertise.
Strict adherence to IS 15298 and IS 1989:2020 quality standards.
Efficient manufacturing powered by advanced machinery.
Cost-competitive offerings driven by efficient sourcing.
Diversified customer base across multiple industrial sectors.

High revenue dependency on the defence and government sectors.
Vulnerable to price volatility for key materials like PU and PVC.
Manufacturing involves hazards like chemical exposure and heavy machinery.

ipos.name: Runwal Enterprises
ipos.about: Runwal Enterprises is a real estate development company primarily focused on the Mumbai market. The company specializes in the development of residential projects, which constitute the majority of its business, alongside selectively developing retail and commercial spaces within mixed-use developments. Its residential portfolio is strategically classified into three distinct segments: affordable, mid-income, and luxury. The affordable segment is concentrated in the Dombivli micro-market, while the mid-income offerings are located in Mulund, Kanjurmarg, Bandra, Chembur, and Alibaug. The luxury segment caters specifically to the South Mumbai sub-market. Runwal Enterprises generates revenue by acquiring land, securing development rights or entering into joint development agreements, and subsequently executing the design, construction, and sale of the developed units. The company relies heavily on pre-sales and a network of channel partners to market its real estate properties to prospective homebuyers and investors.
strengths: Diverse portfolio across affordable, mid-income, and luxury segments.
Strong development pipeline of 28 ongoing and 33 upcoming projects.
Proven track record in developing mixed-use commercial and retail spaces.
Robust channel partner network driving significant sales growth.
Debt reduction via fresh issue proceeds to boost financial health.

Execution risks, timeline delays, and potential construction cost overruns.
High unsold inventory of 7,072 units impacting cash flows.
Land title defects, pending approvals, and regulatory compliance risks.
Complete reliance on third-party contractors for project construction.

ipos.name: German Green Steel and Power (GTMT)
ipos.about: German Green Steel and Power is a vertically integrated iron and steel manufacturer primarily operating in the western region of India. The company focuses on manufacturing thermo-mechanically treated bars, mild steel billets, and sponge iron. It serves a diversified client base comprising distributors, dealers, and direct institutional customers across sectors like real estate, roadways, and thermal plants. The company operates two manufacturing facilities located in Samakhiyali and Viramgam in Gujarat. A notable feature of its operations is the integration of captive coal-based power plants, waste heat recovery systems, and hybrid wind and solar power setups, which provide cost-effective energy for its intensive manufacturing requirements. The company generates revenue predominantly from domestic sales within Gujarat, complemented by minor international exports, positioning itself as a key supplier in the regional steel supply chain.
strengths: Vertically integrated iron and steel manufacturer in Gujarat.
Captive and hybrid wind-solar plants reduce operational energy costs.
Diversified network of distributors, dealers, and institutional clients.
Strong capacity expansion strategy for TMT bars and value-added products.
ISO-certified manufacturing facilities ensuring stringent product quality.

Vulnerability to raw material price volatility and supply disruptions.
Operations are highly concentrated geographically within Gujarat.
Expansion plans face risks of delays, cost overruns, and missing approvals.
High indebtedness with stringent covenants could restrict operations.

ipos.name: Orient Cables
ipos.about: Orient Cables is a manufacturer and exporter of networking cables, optical fibre cables, and passive networking infrastructure components. The company produces a wide range of products including E-beam irradiated specialty cables, keystone jacks, power cords, and control cables across its three manufacturing facilities, with two located in Rajasthan and one in Karnataka. The core business generates revenue primarily from the business-to-business sale of networking cables and solutions to domestic and international markets, including the Middle East, North America, and various other countries. Orient Cables procures raw materials such as copper, polyvinyl chloride compounds, high-density polyethylene, and masterbatches from third-party suppliers to produce its goods. The company operates multiple production units to maintain capacity for its networking and allied products, aiming to serve as a comprehensive provider of passive cable ecosystem components for telecommunications, automotive, and other end-user industries.
strengths: Three strategic manufacturing units across Rajasthan and Karnataka.
Diversified passive networking and specialty cable product portfolio.
Established global and domestic quality certifications (BIS, UL, CE).
Broad market reach across India and export destinations like the Middle East.
Early mover advantage in organized domestic keystone jack manufacturing.

Top 10 customers account for over 84% of total revenue.
Uncertain market acceptance for planned new product line expansions.
Foreign anti-dumping duties and tariffs may reduce export competitiveness.

ipos.name: Snapdeal
ipos.about: AceVector (formerly Snapdeal Limited) runs three online businesses. Snapdeal is a budget shopping marketplace. It holds no stock of its own and earns marketing, advertising and delivery fees from sellers. Unicommerce, a listed subsidiary, sells subscription software that helps online sellers manage orders, inventory and shipping. Stellaro Brands sells its own ethnic wear brand, Rangita.In FY2026, AceVector’s revenue was ₹510.38 Crore, with Snapdeal contributing 57.54% and Unicommerce 40.04%. That year, Snapdeal delivered 25.98 million units across 18,972 pin codes, and Unicommerce served 8,261 clients. The company’s key moat is a zero-inventory model aimed at value shoppers in smaller cities, with courier and cloud costs shared across its businesses. Listed peers named in the RHP are Nykaa, FirstCry and Meesho.The company was founded in 2007 by Kunal Bahl and Rohit Kumar Bansal. They are its promoters along with SoftBank’s Starfish I Pte. Ltd., and together they hold 53.24% before the offer. Other pre-IPO investors include Nexus, eBay and Dunearn.
strengths: Segment Leadership:Per the 1Lattice report (company-commissioned), Snapdeal is a top-two value marketplace and Unicommerce is the largest e-commerce SaaS.
Asset-Light Model:Snapdeal holds no inventory. Tech and fixed costs per delivered unit fell 65.22% to ₹28.99 between FY2024 and FY2026.
Repeat-Driven Growth:Delivered units rose to 25.98 million in FY2026 from 14.81 million in FY2024, with 82.91% from repeat customers.
Profitable SaaS Arm:Unicommerce revenue roughly doubled to ₹204.34 Crore in FY2026, with an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 20.20%.
In-House Technology:In FY2026, 72.69% of Snapdeal orders came through AI recommendations, without the customer typing a search.
risks: Continued Losses:Net losses were ₹45.51 Crore in FY2026 and ₹126.31 Crore in FY2025. Operating cash flow was negative in FY2024–FY2026.
Snapdeal Concentration:Snapdeal contributed 57.54% of revenue in FY2026. The company flags rising user-acquisition costs.
Unicommerce Control Risk:AceVector owns only 26.13% of Unicommerce. If it loses board control, it can no longer consolidate Unicommerce’s results.
Pending Litigation:Cases against the company total ₹61.11 Crore. Criminal complaints against promoters and a fraud complaint to SEBI are pending.
Courier Dependence:All deliveries rely on third-party logistics firms, whose operations, vehicles and staff the company does not control.
objectsOfIssue: Marketing and business promotion expense of Marketplace (132 (45.99%))

ipos.name: Himalayan Solar
ipos.about: Himalayan Solar provides integrated turnkey solar energy solutions, specializing in the design, manufacturing, supply, installation, and commissioning of solar products, with a primary focus on Solar Water Pumping Systems. The company also offers solar energy solutions for Solar Inverter Charge Systems and Solar Rooftop Power Systems. As an empanelled solar partner with several state government departments in India, it generates revenue primarily through orders and government project contracts, having executed over 85,000 HP capacity of Solar Water Pumping Systems. The company operates a manufacturing facility in Karnal, Haryana, covering an area of approximately 25,000 square feet, which produces Mono PERC Solar PV Modules. It serves government departments, contractors, and private customers across India through its dealer network. The company proposes to expand and upgrade its manufacturing capacity to 160 MW per annum using issue proceeds.

Executed over 85,000 HP capacity of solar water pumping systems.
Integrated turnkey capability spanning design, manufacturing, supply, and installation.
In-house facility producing high-efficiency Mono PERC solar PV modules.
Strong pending order book position providing clear revenue visibility.

Business relies on government schemes, incentives, and direct customer subsidies.

ipos.name: Bench Mark Infotech Services
ipos.about: Bench Mark Infotech Services provides integrated IT infrastructure solutions, turnkey IT projects, networking, communication, video surveillance, fibre optic infrastructure, cloud-based services, compute and data storage solutions, facility support, and annual maintenance contracts. It generates revenue through the sale of IT equipment and hardware, execution of turnkey infrastructure projects, and provision of fibre infrastructure leasing and support services. The company participates in competitive tender-based bidding processes to secure government and public sector contracts while delivering customized technology infrastructure integration and support services. Its core business activities encompass the supply, installation, testing, commissioning, ongoing maintenance, and technical management of digital infrastructure and IT systems tailored to client specifications across various operating segments and regional markets.

Long-standing customer relationships resulting in repeat order flows.

Established partnerships with major equipment OEM vendors.
Experienced promoter team with technical industry expertise.

ipos.name: Dudani Retail
ipos.about: Dudani Retail is a fashion and lifestyle company engaged in designing, manufacturing, sourcing, and supplying a diverse range of apparel for women and men, alongside trading personal care products. The company operates through its own-brand business, licensed manufacturing, and quick-commerce supply arrangements. Its women’s wear portfolio, marketed under the brand “Divena,” features ethnic and fusion garments, including suit sets, kurtas, dresses, tunics, and lehengas. For men, the company trades contemporary apparel under the “Millennial Men” brand, while lifestyle products are offered under “Cosse”. Dudani Retail also manufactures apparel for several licensed labels, such as Roadster and Taavi, functioning on a just-in-time basis for major e-commerce platforms. Key manufacturing processes, including cutting, stitching, and finishing, are executed in-house at its facility in Jaipur, Rajasthan, while value-added processing like dyeing and embroidery is outsourced, ensuring scalable and flexible operations.

Strong distribution network across major e-commerce platforms.
Strategic licensed manufacturing for top brands like Roadster.

ipos.name: Sai Urja Indo Ventures
ipos.about: Sai Urja Indo Ventures Limited provides operation and maintenance services primarily to power generation facilities, along with industrial units in the iron, steel, and agrochemical sectors. The company’s core operations involve managing plant routines, electrical systems, control and instrumentation maintenance, housekeeping, and specialized industrial support activities. Operating mainly out of Maharashtra, the business relies on an in-house engineering and technical workforce to execute projects across multiple Indian states. The company specializes in thermal power plant operations, maintaining equipment performance, and handling fuel logistics such as railway sidings and coal handling plants.

Strong and growing order book value providing clear visibility on future revenues.
Established long-term client relationships primarily with Public Sector Undertakings.
